01 / Workflow

Local orchestration, remote QA

One lead owns the decisions

Claude Code coordinates the work. The user approves the plan and makes the final shipping decision.

Two providers, separate contexts

Claude agents plan and build. Codex validates the pushed commit on the QA VPS.

The existing diagram labels k3d. This VPS uses Kind.
The harness supports both.

03 / VPS execution & acceptance

A fresh environment for each commit

The VPS persists. Each QA job creates its own Kubernetes cluster and removes it when finished.

01

Freeze & dispatch

Rebase, rerun gates, push the exact SHA. Send the clean QA charter over SSH.

02

Prepare the VPS

Serialize jobs. Stop existing QA infrastructure. Create Kind, start the required Tilt services and seed data.

03

Try to break it

Codex runs required checks across tests, APIs, persisted data and browser behavior. Capture evidence.

04

Return & clean up

Return verdict, logs and checksums. Remove the job cluster. Leave previous infrastructure stopped.

PASS

The checker validates commit and evidence integrity. The lead reads the evidence before advancing to PR and CI.

FAIL

Reproduce defects and confirm scope before fixing. Maximum two fix rounds. Bank unrelated findings.

INCOMPLETE

Repair QA and rerun the same commit. After two failed reruns, escalate. An interrupted check cannot pass.

Authentication target: use the stored Clerk credentials for a real session and seed the matching identity. The latest sign-in failure remains unresolved. Do not silently replace real authentication with USER_SESSION.
